scope: 26 frozen validation scenes only; exploratory mechanism probe, not final benchmark
shared_support: 8x8 blocks, valid_support excluding saturation; lowest 20% ranked by maximum A/B smoothed guide gradient energy
noise_delta: pooled MAD sigmaA squared minus sigmaB squared on the same selected blocks
uncertainty: 64 block bootstrap replicates on fixed selected spatial support; seed 7281; not calibrated independent-noise confidence
controlled_change: replace only the differential mean energy correction by 20*delta; retain original global-sigma variance model, sigmoid, median and guided filter
fallback: fewer than two eligible blocks gives zero differential correction
oracle: oracle_added_only knows injected RGB noise variance and assumes no residual baseline noise; NOT a true total-noise oracle for original photos
selection: No parameter search, no heldout access, no GT used in candidate estimator
